Hi Priyom,

We're finalizing the PO and our finance team asked whether Redwood can provide a single invoice that splits the total across three legal entities for our internal chargebacks and VAT reclaim. We need:

- Line-level split: 60% charged to QuantaBio US, 30% to QuantaBio EU, 10% to QuantaBio APAC
- Each line must show the remit-to / tax ID for that entity
- A consolidated summary page for accounts-payable

Can you confirm if you can issue a multi-entity invoice (single PDF) and what information you need from our side (exact entity names, VAT numbers, PO instructions)? Also confirm whether Redwood will apply withholding tax or leave gross amounts as-is.

Sara —

Thanks for the details. We can definitely provide a single PDF invoice that contains:

1) Invoice cover with consolidated total and PO reference
2) Line items broken out into tranche A/B/C matching your 60/30/10 split (we'll prorate line items)
3) Per-tranche remit details and tax/VAT ID fields visible under each tranche
4) A final summary table showing per-entity amounts and GL codes for your upload

What we need from you to proceed:
- Exact legal entity names and VAT/tax IDs for the three destinations (US/EU/APAC)
- Preferred remit-to (bank details or AP portal) for each entity
- PO matching rules (do you require line-level PO refs or consolidated PO header?)
- Any required invoice reference prefix for AP to match (e.g., QB-4821/RED-INV)

On withholding tax: Redwood will invoice gross. If your jurisdiction requires withholding, please provide the treaty/withholding instructions and we will include a note on the invoice. We do not deduct withheld amounts by default.

I'll draft the tranche layout and send a preview PDF once you share the tax IDs.

Best,
Priyom Das
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
